profile.network: 150ms network latency, 1.6 Mbps down, 750 Kbps up

limitation: Synthetic fixtures. Event Timing omits interactions below 16ms. eventToFirstAnimationFrameProxy measures Event.timeStamp to the first requestAnimationFrame callback; it is a frame-timing proxy, not confirmed paint, INP, field data, or an SLA.

derivedVisitProxy.method: For each scripted journey, take the maximum event-to-first-animation-frame proxy among its captured click/keydown/input/change events; summarize the 30 per-journey maxima. This is not INP.
